entry.name: 智能体团队 · 技能管理工作台

description.zh: 一支 17 人具名智能体团队：每人独立表情与配色、一组可回退的模型路由；内置三级审批流水线（执行方→审核员→复核员）与本机共享技能库管理。
description.en: A 17-member named agent team: per-member emoji and color, layered model routes with fallback, a three-stage approval pipeline, and a local shared skill library.
